main.description: A poem plus the keystroke track that produced it. The track is the work; the finished text is a convenience for indexers and readers who only want the result.

text.description: The finished poem. Must equal the result of applying every step in the track in order.

track.description: Inline keystroke track. Use for short poems. Roughly 40 bytes per character written, so past a few thousand characters use trackBlob instead.

trackBlob.description: The same array of steps, stored as a JSON blob. Use instead of track when the track is large. Exactly one of track or trackBlob should be present.

prompt.description: What the poem was written in response to, if anything.

startedAt.description: When the first key was pressed. With createdAt this bounds the real elapsed time of composition.

durationMs.description: Sum of all step delays. Cached so clients can show a length without loading the track.

reply.description: A poem written in response to another poem.

step.description: One edit event. Deletions are applied before insertions.

delay.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the previous step. The first step's delay is time from startedAt.

deleteCount.description: Characters removed from the end of the current text before addText is applied.

addText.description: Characters appended. Longer than one grapheme means a paste, which players may choose to mark.
